knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The walk-through checks the finished room from the guest's view with a checklist, before release. It does not repeat the work.
Unfixed faults are recorded and raised before release. They are not left or hidden.
A fixed order with ticks as you go means no point is missed and nothing is ticked from memory.

practicalCriteria: Walks a simulated room in the set order and ticks each checklist item as it is reached, as observed.
Finds at least two seeded faults (for example a dust mark and an open bin lid) and fixes or records each one.
Completes the checklist, initials and times it, and does not release the room while an item is unresolved.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Photos at the points the business requires
stopWorkCriteria: Room released with an unresolved fault
Chemicals, tools or cloths left in the room
